thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up — console /analytics is hanging ~2s on page load when 8+ panels. Started after today's deploy. Anyone else?
Ben Patel: Yup. Repro here. Network waterfall shows huge vendor chunk and multiple full JS parses. FCP ~1.2s -> 3.4s.
Kai Lopez: I profiled. Main bundle jumped after PR #842 (plotrix v2). plotrix pulled in d3 + intl polyfills. bundle sizes: main 350KB -> 1.1MB, vendor 420KB -> 2.9MB.
Sasha Ivanov: Oof. We should lazy-load the custom heatmap and the explorer widget. Also enable splitChunks + cacheGroups for plotrix vendor.
Ben Patel: Quick numbers from curl:
curl -I https://console/assets/vendor-abc.js
HTTP/2 200
content-length: 2912345
cache-control: public, max-age=31536000

Also Lighthouse before/after: LCP 1.1s -> 4.2s, TTI 1.6s -> 6.5s.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 10% for commit sha abc123 (PR #842).
Maria Chen: Can we pause canary? That's causing customer-facing regressions.
Kai Lopez: I disabled auto-canary via deploy tool. Reverting PR would be fastest but we need that heatmap fix for a customer.
Sasha Ivanov: Plan: 1) revert canary/rollout pause (done), 2) create a hotfix that dynamic-imports plotrix for heatmap route, 3) backfill telemetry to record bundle sizes and cache-hit rates per route. I'll open PR.
Ben Patel: Also suggest adding runtime chunk for intl polyfills only when needed: import('intl/locale-data').
Liam (prod): Noted — Datadog alert perf:chart_load_time spiked x3 since 09:12 UTC. Link: https://app.datadog/graph?query=perf%3Achart_load_time
Maria Chen: For the hotfix let's make it non-breaking: dynamic import + fallback to legacy simple svg chart.
Sasha Ivanov: PR 849 opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/849 — includes webpack splitChunks tweak and lazy import. Tests passing locally. Requesting review from @Ben.
Ben Patel: Reviewing now. Quick suggestion: add network fallback to show skeletons while chunk loads.
Kai Lopez: Also we should add a small LRU cache in frontend for panel queries (5 min TTL) to reduce duplicate fetches during re-renders.
Maria Chen: Action items: Sasha: PR 849, Kai: client caching + metrics, Ben: review + skeletons, Ops: hold canary until patch. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Canary paused for sha abc123.
Sasha Ivanov: Will merge after Ben's review and then trigger a controlled canary at 2%.
Ben Patel: LGTM after minor comments. Merging.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — monitoring telemetry. If things look good we'll promote.
Liam (prod): Perf metric down to ~1.3x baseline after merge. Good sign. :rocket:
